hooks.prompt:
A specification file in specs/ was just written or edited. Review it.

Hook payload (the edited file path is in tool_input.file_path): $ARGUMENTS

First read .claude/agents/spec-reviewer.md and follow it as your instructions, and read .claude/rules/specs.md for the standard the spec is held to. Then read the edited spec file and review it against them.

You do NOT have the conversation in which this spec was agreed, so you CANNOT verify traceability. Do not guess at it. Instead, list under 'Untraceable' every line that reads like an authored preference rather than a recorded decision — invented thresholds, field lists, file layouts, error paths, script names, acceptance checks nobody asked for — so the session can confirm each against what was actually agreed.

Judge falsifiability and scope fully; those need no conversation.

Be brief. Findings only, no restatement of the spec.
